Aries.desc: Aries is the first sign of the zodiac. Bold and ambitious, Aries dives headfirst into challenging situations.
Aries.love: Passionate and direct in love. Best matches: Leo, Sagittarius, Gemini.
Aries.career: Natural leaders. Great for entrepreneurship, military, sports, and management.
Aries.health: Prone to headaches and stress. Regular exercise helps channel excess energy.
Aries.today: Your energy is at peak today. Take initiative and start new projects. Financial opportunities await!

Taurus.desc: Taurus is an earth sign represented by the bull. Taureans enjoy relaxing in serene environments.
Taurus.love: Loyal and sensual in love. Best matches: Virgo, Capricorn, Cancer.
Taurus.career: Excel in finance, art, cooking, and architecture.
Taurus.health: Watch out for throat issues. Enjoy nature walks and relaxation.
Taurus.today: Focus on financial matters today. A good day for long-term investments and home improvements.

Gemini.desc: Gemini is a versatile and curious sign. Represented by twins, Geminis have two sides to their personality.
Gemini.love: Playful and intellectual in love. Best matches: Libra, Aquarius, Aries.
Gemini.career: Great communicators. Excel in journalism, teaching, sales, and writing.
Gemini.health: Prone to nervous tension. Meditation and breathing exercises help.
Gemini.today: Communication is your superpower today. Network and socialize — great connections await!

Cancer.desc: Cancer is the cardinal water sign. Represented by the crab, Cancers are deeply intuitive and sentimental.
Cancer.love: Deeply caring in love. Best matches: Scorpio, Pisces, Taurus.
Cancer.career: Excel in nursing, childcare, real estate, and cooking.
Cancer.health: Watch digestive health. Home comforts and family time are healing.
Cancer.today: Trust your gut today. Family matters need attention. A nurturing gesture will go a long way.

Leo.desc: Leo is the royal sign of the zodiac. Leos are natural leaders who love being in the spotlight.
Leo.love: Romantic and generous in love. Best matches: Aries, Sagittarius, Gemini.
Leo.career: Born performers. Excel in acting, politics, management, and entertainment.

Virgo.desc: Virgo is the sign of service and precision. Virgos are known for their analytical minds and attention to detail.

Virgo.career: Excel in medicine, research, accounting, and editing.

Libra.career: Excel in law, diplomacy, design, and counseling.
